standard.title: Selective Disclosure for JSON Web Tokens

implementations.role: independent Rust disclosure parser and digest implementation
independent Rust disclosure parser and digest implementation

checks: each published disclosure parses in both implementations
each SHA-256 base64url digest matches the RFC example
both implementations return the same digest
object-property versus array-element disclosure shape is checked
both implementations agree on published salts, claim names, disclosure kinds, and decoded claim contents
both parsers reject malformed base64url disclosure input
both parsers reject malformed disclosure JSON and invalid array shapes
both parsers reject non-string salts and object-property names
nonclaims: key-binding JWT signature, nonce, audience, or replay validation
